Container.Name: uhppote-desk
Container.Overview: Management of UHPPOTE UT0311-L0x access controllers. Requires "host" networking to discover the controllers and receive their UDP events. User interface in English, Italian, Spanish, French and German.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that will own the data folder (Unraid: 99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that will own the data folder (Unraid: 100 = users)

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port of the web interface (host networking: change it if already used by another container)

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password of the admin user, applied at every start. If empty, a password is generated on the first start (see the log) and must be changed at first login

Config.Name: Local IP facing the controllers
Config.Description: Server IP on the controllers' network (0.0.0.0 = all interfaces)

Config.Name: Discovery broadcast
Config.Description: Broadcast address used to discover controllers; the broadcast of the controllers' subnet is recommended, e.g. 192.168.1.255:60000

Config.Name: Event listen address
Config.Description: UDP address:port on which events are received

Config.Name: Event destination
Config.Description: IP:port of this server as reached by the controllers, e.g. 192.168.1.10:60001 (without it events arrive only through periodic polling)

Config.Name: HTTPS-only cookies
Config.Description: true if published behind an HTTPS reverse proxy

Config.Name: MQTT broker
Config.Description: Home Assistant integration: MQTT broker URL, e.g. mqtt://192.168.1.10:1883 (empty = disabled). See docs/HOME-ASSISTANT.md

Config.Name: MQTT door control
Config.Description: false = Home Assistant can see the doors but not open them

Config.Name: MQTT language
Config.Description: Language of the Home Assistant entity names and event texts: en, it, es, fr, de

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for the time set on the controllers and for reports
